name: Eisklettern im Kaunertal
beschreibung:
The Kaunertal is one of the Alps' most renowned ice climbing destinations. Deep, shaded gorges and a high-altitude setting ensure frozen waterfalls are reliably climbable from December to March in prime condition.

Sectors & Routes

The Mühlbachfall Ice Park in Feichten (approx. 5 min from the Quellalpin car park) is perfect for beginners, with floodlit evening sessions. Advanced climbers head to the Renkfälle (near Fendels, up to 200 m, 15 routes), the Eisgarten at Platz (60 m, WI 4–5+) and routes along the Kaunertal Glacier Road: Angst vor Lust (130 m, WI 3–6), Der Gelbe Fluss (WI 5), Der Zwirn (160 m, WI 6) and Bodenbachfall (160 m, WI 5).

Taster ice climbing at Mühlbachfall: Price approx. €65 per person incl. full rental equipment (boots, crampons, helmet, harness, ice tools). Duration: 2–2.5 hours. Season: late November/December to mid/late March; best conditions January–February.

Getting There

By train to Landeck-Zams, then VVT ski bus 230 to Feichten. By car: A12 motorway to Landeck, then the Kaunertal road. Parking at the Quellalpin cultural centre.

Tips

  • Minimum age: Top-rope taster from approx. 12–14 years.
  • Safety: Avalanche risk at many ice fall approaches – check the daily Tyrol avalanche bulletin (lawine.tirol.gv.at). Mountain rescue: 140.
  • Provider: Kaunertaler Berg- & Skiführer, Tel. +43 664 472 1100, kaunertaler-bergfuehrer.com.
